# d10 agent status: C^4 (x) C^5 (x) C^5, rank 8 vs rank 9 (isotypic flattenings, all degrees in the job queue)
Updated 2026-10-25 03:35 UTC. Work is pushed to the shared branch `claude/wonderful-fermat-1v76ux` (mirror `claude/tender-hopper-mcnmta`).
Setting: T in C^4 (x) C^5 (x) C^5 (generic rank 9, sigma_8 of codimension 4). "Separates" = smaller flattening rank on a random rank-8
tensor than on a random rank-9 tensor. Tool: `sweep_fast.py 4,5,5 d 8,9 5 <k> 3 noV` (d9 agent's Cauchy-Binet / float64-BLAS evaluator,
generalised to different factor dimensions; exact mod p = 524287; components = (l1; {l2,l3}) unordered in the two C^5 factors, all with
Kronecker coefficient g > 0; three flattening directions; gN = generic functional, HN = full multiplicity space stacked). 3 workers (4 from d = 10 on), seed 5.
